title: CSM session retrospective (last ~10 days): repeating issues, gaps, inefficiencies, and fixes

tldr.content: Across the last ~10 days of csm-plan/csm-build/csm-deep-research sessions, the same issues repeat: (1) gates run only in CI, so features land with 1-3 lint/format/orphan-test/regen fixup commits (9/33 CI runs failed); (2) regeneration order (fmt->gen-capabilities->pack-bootstrap) is a recurring trap; (3) plan lineage is weak - 21 plans/1 goal, 113 orphaned tasks, 22/31 plans fail readPlanArtifact on digest-mismatch; (4) repair work and applicability obligations are never closed in the durable fields; (5) traces are near-empty (9 lines across the log files, 0 decisions) because nothing auto-emits them; (6) progress records are batch snapshots with impossible timestamps and boilerplate milestones; (7) flaky tests and leftover merged worktrees/branches persist; (8) a recurring 'mock passes, live path broken' class. Fix by shifting the gate into the loop, a single regen entrypoint, plan-lineage validation, mandatory repair/obligation/trace emission, and cleanup-at-session-end.

executiveSummary.content:
DEEP x hybrid retrospective over ~10 days of CSM sessions, using the durable corpus (48 commits, ~31 plans, ~21 in-window research findings, 37 progress records, 9 trace lines) plus 33 CI runs.

Pipeline: INTAKE -> TRIAGE(DEEP x hybrid) -> RESEARCH(4 tracks: plans/build-state; research findings; progress/traces; git/CI/process) -> SYNTHESIZE -> CHALLENGE -> JUDGE -> REMEDIATE -> VERIFY -> SAVED.

Headline: the CSM artifacts are rich but the enforcement of their own contracts is thin - gates live at the repo edge, plan digests drift, repair/obligation fields are write-only, and telemetry (traces) is declared but not emitted. The fixes are mostly mechanical and can be enforced by extending check-suite/loop guards.

keyFindings.content: K1 the same lint/format/orphan/regen fixups recur (claim-regen-coupling, claim-commit-then-fix). K2 plan lineage is weak: 21 plans/1 goal, 113 orphaned tasks, 22/31 readPlanArtifact digest-mismatch (claim-plan-lineage). K3 repair + applicability obligations are never closed in fields (claim-repair-unrecorded, claim-obligations-open). K4 traces are near-empty and nothing auto-emits them (claim-trace-empty). K5 progress records are batch snapshots with impossible timestamps/boilerplate (claim-progress-weak). K6 'mock passes, live path broken' is a recurring defect class (claim-lived-mock-gap).

detailSections.content:
A. CI/fixups: 9/33 runs failed; fixups b937e70/b955ac3 (lint+format of the context fix), 1e7110b/37569ee/36b237f (orphan/HEAD-brittle/format of jev), 9ae502e (payload import graph), e63048b/48f84a4 (store flake), be130fd (corpus), fd679ae (index), e862f79 (index). ci.yml runs the whole gate only at CI; branches-ignore wt/**.
B. Regen coupling: discoveredRequirements pack/payload 9, orphan 5, registry digest 4, capabilities 4, fmt/lint 4; 18 commits bundle payload+source.
C. Lineage: dynamic-worker-runtime 21 plans (12 superseded, 7 unlinked terminal completes, original terminal); broker-upstream 7 open tasks orphaned; 'complete the prototype decision gate...' pending in 12 plans; 12/31 superseded plans label control.currentState STOP (a vocabulary label; control.status matches status 31/31); 23/23 build-state artifacts[] empty, 14/23 contradict plan status.
D. Repair/obligations: repairAttempts 0/330; critiqueResolution empty 10/31; obligations 254 required/8 satisfied; dddArtifacts 31/31 empty; 39 spike candidates unused; rdRecord 1 row in 24/31.
E. Traces: 9 lines (wt-session 4, csm-build 3 incl sample, csm-review 2 worker-start); 0 decisions; 0/4 runIds match progress; two log files for the same actor.
F. Progress: 8/37 unfinished (5%-92%); 6 identical deep-research milestone signatures; verifiedFraction 19/161; 8 records updatedAt<startedAt; 120h backfill gaps.
G. Flaky/allowlist: migration race (f4949f7->e63048b->48f84a4), daemon hang (e07d84a run 35440413429 -> 6beb11c), port-9225 deferred, 7 allowlisted suites in check-suite KNOWN_UNWIRED_TESTS.
H. Worktrees: 6 merged worktrees still registered in csm-wt/; 6 merged branches persist; cleanup removed 2 worktrees but kept their branches.
I. Live/mock: jev claim-k2-transport-mismatch; trace claim-k2-no-auto-hook; canonical JSON corpus ungated.

recommendation.content: Devise the fixes as enforceable gates, not prose. (1) Shift the gate into the loop: extend the existing lefthook pre-commit (which already runs staged check-suite/oxlint/oxfmt) with a composite `make precommit` that adds the missing regenerators and tests (`make fmt && node scripts/gen-capabilities.mjs && node scripts/pack-bootstrap.mjs && node scripts/check-suite.mjs && make test-suite-tooling`), and require csm-build CHECKPOINT and csm-plan SAVE to run it before committing - this removes the commit-then-fix cycle [ref-fowler-ci]. (2) Single regen entrypoint `scripts/regen.mjs` (fmt -> gen-capabilities -> pack-bootstrap) that every writer calls; check-suite already detects drift. (3) Plan-lineage gate: extend check-suite/loop guard to fail unless every terminal goal has exactly one terminal plan, no terminal plan retains blockers/open tasks, and every plan passes readPlanArtifact (fix the digest authoring so it is content-minus-digest). (4) Close the write-only fields at COMPLETE: set applicability obligations to satisfied/not_applicable, increment repairAttempts on each REPAIR, write critiqueResolution rows, require a reason when dddArtifacts is empty, and clear or promote spikeCandidate. (5) Emit traces automatically: land the uncommitted trace-hook plan (trace-hooks.mjs + loop-guard/CLI emit + AGENTS.md exact command) and add a state-transition trace + decision-kind record; register the trace in the config as already done. (6) Validate progress records: fail on updatedAt<startedAt, on un-finalized records at CHECKPOINT, and require verifiedFraction when a milestone is claimed complete; derive milestones from the plan execution graph to kill boilerplate. (7) Flaky policy: each allowlisted suite gets an owner + expiry and a fresh-state retry; fix or delete the 7 KNOWN_UNWIRED_TESTS. (8) Cleanup at session end: wt-session create auto-sweeps and AGENTS.md requires `cleanup --dry-run` then `--apply`; reap merged branches on nuke; add a check that no merged worktree/branch remains. (9) Foreign concurrency: keep worktree isolation, make merge require a clean main (or auto-reconcile), and scope commits to owned paths instead of --no-verify. (10) No-mock-only rule: adapters/durable writers must have at least one live or contract-fixture test exercising the real wire shape (kills the mock-passes-live-broken class). Confidence high; would change only if the fixes are shown to break live consumers. Prioritize in this order: (1) precommit/regen gate, (5) trace emission, (3) plan-lineage gate, (4) close write-only fields, (2) regen entrypoint, then (6)-(10).

processAppendix.content: Tier DEEP x hybrid. Tracks: A plans/build-state (explore); B research findings (explore); C progress/traces (explore); D git/CI/process (explore). Synthesis primary-only. CHALLENGE and JUDGE dispatched independently. Journal: 0 INTAKE, 1 TRIAGE, 2 RESEARCH, 3 SYNTHESIZE, 4 CHALLENGE, 5 JUDGE, 6 REMEDIATE, 7 VERIFY, 8 SAVED. Remediation (challenge+judge): corrected the fixup count (~10-11) and removed a non-resolving SHA; pack/payload regen 9 entries/6 plans; control.currentState is a vocabulary label (control.status matches 31/31); REVIEW->REPAIR is 5 edges/3 plans; spike candidates ~45/37; trace count made consistent (9 across files, 6 in trace.jsonl); cleanup 6 worktrees + ~6 orphan branches; fixed mis-cited locators (repairAttempts -> csm-plan schema; verifiedFraction -> progress-tracker) and softened the CI quote; cited ref-fowler-ci.

claims.statement: Sessions repeatedly shipped a commit and then answered the resulting CI failure with 1-3 follow-up fixup commits: 9 of 33 in-window CI runs failed and ~10-11 fixups are identifiable (lint, format, orphan-test wiring, HEAD-brittle test, corpus/index, payload import graph).

citations.locator: Repository gates: fmt-check, lint, check, test suites
citations.quote: the full test/regen gate runs at CI; the pre-commit hook only covers staged lint/format/check-suite

claims.statement: The most repeated discovered requirements are regeneration/ordering couplings: pack-bootstrap/payload regen (9 entries across 6 plans), orphan-test Makefile wiring (5/5), registry schemaContentDigest (4/4), capabilities regen (4/3), and fmt/lint ordering (4/4); ~18 in-window commits bundled regenerated payload with source.

Plan/lineage integrity is weak: one goal (dynamic-worker-runtime) spawned 21 plans; 113 tasks remain non-completed inside superseded plans (the prototype decision-gate task is pending in 12 plans); supersession covers only 12 of 21; 22 of 31 plans fail readPlanArtifact with digest-mismatch while validatePlanArtifact passes; 15/31 have empty sourceDigests; 12/31 superseded plans label control.currentState as STOP (a vocabulary, not a control.status contradiction, which matches 31/31) and 2 ready plans use NOT_STARTED.

citations.quote: plan digest does not match content

claims.statement: Repair work is not recorded in the durable fields: repairAttempts is 0 across all 330 tasks despite 5 REVIEW->REPAIR journal edges across 3 plans (4 plans have any REPAIR edge) and explicit 'REPAIRED F1..F7' entries; critiqueResolution is empty in 10/31 plans and rdRecord is a single catch-all row in 24/31.

Applicability obligations are write-only: 254 obligations are 'required' vs 8 'satisfied'; every terminal complete plan still lists its obligations as required; dddArtifacts is empty in 31/31; 28/31 plans are warranted with empty lightweight slices; ~45 real spike candidates sit in plans where 37 have no SPIKE task.

The trace feature is effectively unused: only 9 trace lines exist across all .agents/logs/*.jsonl (6 in trace.jsonl; 8 session-written), of which 0 are decisions; 0 of 4 trace runIds match any of 37 progress runIds; csm-plan, csm-deep-research and csm-grill emit zero traces; the only production writer is wt-session (plus a csm-build test seam); no automatic hook records ordinary agent actions (at production time).

Progress tracking is often a batch snapshot, not live tracking: 8 of 37 records are un-finalized (7 active, 1 blocked); 6/8 deep-research records share an identical boilerplate milestone signature; verifiedFraction appears on only 19/161 milestones; 8 records have updatedAt earlier than startedAt (impossible); multi-day updatedAt-startedAt gaps (up to ~120h) show late backfill.

Flaky/hanging tests recur: a concurrent first-open migration race failed twice before a fresh-DB retry fixed it; a daemon exit hang failed CI with no failed-step log and was root-caused (ready-marker/disconnect race); a host port (9225) contention is left to CI; and check-suite allowlists 7 known-unwired failing suites.

Cleanup is incomplete: 6 registered worktrees whose branches are already merged into main remain, plus ~6 orphaned merged branches (12 merged local branches total); two worktrees removed by cleanup still have their branches; cleanup/registry is not run automatically at session end.

A recurring defect class is 'tests pass against a mock while the live/durable path is inert or wrong': the Jev transport mismatch returned HTTP 400 live yet offline tests passed against the array mock; the trace hook was declared but never emitted; the canonical JSON plan/build corpus was ungated while legacy Markdown was checked.

Concurrent sessions interfere through the shared checkout: a dirty main blocked an ff-only merge and required a stash/restore/regen reconcile; --no-verify is a standing user policy triggered by the unstaged-guard; 4 pushed commits received no CI run and ci.yml ignores wt/** branches.

The pre-commit gate is routinely bypassed (--no-verify standing policy) because the unstaged-guard trips on concurrent/foreign tracked edits; 1 explicit in-window commit, count is a lower bound since git does not record bypasses.
